name: context-builder-agent
description: Programmatic Copilot Chat Participant @build_context to scan, parse, and build semantic context graphs.

contextBuilder.serverDirectory.description: Absolute path to the context_builder server directory (the folder containing main.py, engine/, db/, and parsers/). When set, the extension runs the MCP server from this directory instead of searching the workspace root. A Python virtual environment at <serverDirectory>/.venv/ is used automatically if present. Changing this setting takes effect when the MCP server process next starts (after a crash or VS Code window reload).

chatParticipants.name: build_context
chatParticipants.description: Scans documents in ./ingest and creates/traces a Semantic Context Graph.

commands.name: ingest
commands.description: Parses requirement files inside ./ingest and runs multi-agent graph mapping.

commands.name: query
commands.description: Queries the local Semantic Context Graph.

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Displays the multi-hop traceability tree for a business rule.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Compares disk files inside ./ingest against active graph store checksums.

commands.name: view
commands.description: Launches an interactive network diagram of the Context Graph inside a VS Code Webview.

commands.name: anomalies
commands.description: Review behavioral anomalies recorded by the relationship-linker. Optional severity filter: critical | warning | info.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
